title: Replication code and Supplementary Material: Pricing geopolitical risk into delivered green hydrogen costs (Algeria-EU, 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure)
description: Route-explicit deterministic delivered-cost model for green hydrogen supplied to the EU from Algeria (pipeline and ammonia) and five competitors (Morocco, Egypt, Oman, Australia, Chile), with country WACC and default-spread betas, bottom-up shipping, canal tolls and war-risk insurance with rerouting; Monte Carlo simulation (10,000 draws), Shapley decomposition, ES95 security premium, break-even GPR, Sobol indices, and an ex-post scenario tested on the observed 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure. All inputs are documented with their sources in params/; outputs are regenerated by src/run_model.py. Version 2.0.0 supersedes v1.0.0, whose econometric design was not estimated.
